title: Bound launcher metadata so oversized stage plans still leave readable terminal evidence
outcome: Launcher metadata that exceeds the host artifact envelope is handled explicitly without oversized unreadable records or silently dropped stage facts.
acceptance: Define and enforce an explicit byte-bounded contract for stage-plan and terminal metadata independent of source_id capacity, preserving actual stage outcomes and refusing unsupported metadata before execution where possible
Cover metadata-only overflow with both source endpoints absent, including a large stage plan, and verify a bounded readable refusal or documented unavailable outcome without silent fact truncation
